scope: The arguments of the node-to-client ledger queries read with the decoders decodeShelleyQuery uses for them: fromCBOR of cardano-binary (sets tag 258 around a definite ascending list, Maybe and Either definite lists) and LC.fromEraCBOR at Conway's lowest protocol version 9 (sets definite or indefinite, tagged or not, without duplicates; a GovActionId a RecD record), at Babbage's 7 (sets untagged, duplicates one) and at Dijkstra's 12 (chunked byte strings; a GovActionId a record of its own); the verdict and the values read; no query server or node is run
referenceNode: 11.1.3 (matching embedded package versions, not a bit-identical node release build)

shelleyQuery.note: decodeShelleyQuery: decodeListLen, then fromCBOR or LC.fromEraCBOR per argument (916-995)

plainFromCBOR.note: Either decodeListLenOf 2 (418-430), decodeMaybe decodeListLen (445-453), decodeSetSkel tag 258, decodeListLen, strictly ascending (550-576)

ledgerDecoder.note: decodeSet at version 9: decodeSetEnforceNoDuplicates, definite or indefinite, tag optional (952-976, 1043-1077); decodeBytes and decodeByteArray take a chunked string from version 12 (350-373, 1426-1448)

govActionId.note: GovActionId: RecD below version 12, decodeRecordNamed over its two fields from 12 (182-190)
